grouping.exchange_boundary: gap between consecutive coda onsets greater than or equal to 8 seconds
grouping.important_note: The notebooks use the same six-character key and eight-second window for speaker-specific call sequences. This index applies the disclosed eight-second boundary across all speakers to support multi-speaker exchange statistics; this is a dataset-derived operational definition, not a semantic annotation.
grouping.position_bins: normalized row position: <=1/3 opening, >=2/3 ending, otherwise middle
grouping.recording_key: first six characters of REC, matching repository notebooks
